_doc: Single source of truth for coverage thresholds. See REPO-STANDARDS-SPEC [COVERAGE-THRESHOLDS-JSON] and docs/specs/SPEC.md. Ratchet only — never lower. Each Rust crate and the VSIX extension have their own line-coverage floor; every test target `make ci` runs must measure against its entry here ([TEST-SELECTION]: `make test` filters no test by name; only the feature-gated corpus suite is out). One sanctioned exception: while the gh #432–#435 skips hold (docs/plans/fused-score-followups.md), deslop-lsp's floor is 91 — the four skipped state-file/history tests carried its src coverage; restoring 95 is part of closing #433/#435.
